title: Canonical Hom comparison with local and restriction compatibility
statement: Let l, E, m≤n, A, B and φ be as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow]. Let S be a scheme and K,N objects of the unbounded derived category of A-modules on S_et [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with K dualizable and etale locally isomorphic to A^r[0] (r≥0 depending on the member of the covering) [def-sf-finite-free-hom-evaluation-coordinates], N bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in an interval [c,d], c≤d [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Then the canonical comparison v:RHom_A(K,N)⊗^L_A B→RHom_B(K⊗^L_A B,N⊗^L_A B) is an isomorphism; for every etale U→S the canonical comparison of the restricted inputs satisfies the finite-free local calculation, and the canonical comparisons over S and U satisfy the restriction square of [def-sf-finite-free-hom-local-calculation].

source.place: Paragraphs 2–3, lisse degree-zero specialization of the site-perfect stratum argument

proof.text: The canonical comparison is invertible by [lem-coef-etale-lisse-canonical-iso].

proof.text: For an etale U→S, [lem-coef-etale-finite-free-hom-local-identity] applied to the restricted inputs is the local predicate, and [lem-coef-etale-perfect-hom-restriction] applied to the dualizable K is the restriction predicate.
